title: Mediocre and that's fine
text: Mediocre and that's fine. If you're looking for a cheap little corner cabinet to give an easy life, this is ok. It screws together well enough that it feels solid. One corner of the bottom started splitting when I twisted the screw in too vigorously, but with a gentler approach it all went fine. The finish is disappointing; it's not satiny like IKEA or similar laminated flat-pack, it just looks like a brown plastic hydrogen peroxide bottle. I may paint it just to give it some texture. I wish it was a little taller.
